name: auto_status
description: Equipment auto-statuses and SOS statuses: apply, restore, the SOS toggle for one character, the per-action sweep over 31 characters (three of them carry the machinery) and the weak level of an HP pair. A vector holds the fields of the character structure the functions read or write, before and after.

function.signature: apply(Chr*), restore(Chr*), toggle(int id, Chr*) -> int, sweep() -> int, weak_level(int hp, int max) -> int

harness.note: the real machine code of each function; the status-marker refresh the toggle calls (0x79eff0, presentation) is hooked and counted in refreshed

notes: in and out hold perm (Chr+0x606), counters (0x608..0x614, 13), extra (0x616), bkPerm (0x618), bkCounters (0x61a..0x626), bkExtra (0x628), live (0x62a, 0x62c, 0x62e), equip (0x630, 0x632, 0x634), sos (0x636, 0x638, 0x63a), sosFlag (0x63c), weak (0x63e), applied (0x63f), regenTicks (0x6d2).
toggle and sweep: ret is the function return value (1 / the number toggled); refreshed counts the status-marker refreshes.
weak: in.hp and in.max are signed 32-bit, out is the level 0 to 3.
